'''Kloff''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Culroon]] who united the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Culroon III/Legends|Culroon III]] and ended the continual conflict through the application of imported energy weapons.

==Biography==
The [[Culroon]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Kloff was born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Culroon III/Legends|Culroon III]], a world with a long history of violence and war. Using imported energy weapons, Kloff managed to unite the fractured planet under his rule. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] arrived, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Irrv]] attempted to attain the Culroon capitulation through a ceremony and exchange of symbolic weapons. During the ceremony, Kloff accepted a [[Naval sword]] from Irrv, and sheathed it in the General's aide, [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jeffers]], before signalling his warriors to [[Insurrection on Culroon III|attack]]. The Imperial force was rescued by the intervention of [[Junior Lieutenant/Legends|Junior Lieutenant]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] and his [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]].<ref name="Promotion" />
